subject: Renewal readiness: procurement portal refresh & tiered capacity addendum
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sally Chen <sally.chen@acme-corp.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal readiness: procurement portal refresh & tiered capacity addendum

Hi Sally / Acme procurement team —

Following up from our renewal planning call last week. We want to make the renewal + capacity uplift as frictionless as possible and align on where the procurement portal will be used vs PO routing. Action items and asks below: 

- Timeline: portal invite -> onboarding -> PO submission -> capacity provisioning. Target: completed onboarding + PO within two weeks of portal access.
- Attachments: procurement_checklist_v2.xlsx (checklist) and tiered_capacity_addendum_v1.pdf (proposed addendum for +25% capacity tiers).
- We need your standard vendor onboarding questionnaire and any platform-specific shipping instructions for vendor manifests (CSV format).
- Please confirm preferred payment terms and whether your AP requires a specific billing contact for separate EWA (early warranty/advance) invoices.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Please send portal invite to vendors@redwood.com (we will accept and register).
2) Procurement uploads: PO template + W9 + any procurement-specific routing rules.
3) Legal will review the addendum once we get your template — we can aim for redline + sign in 48–72 hours after receipt.

Deal reference: ACME-RNW-3249. If helpful I included a short checklist in the attached xlsx.

Thanks — happy to run a quick screen-share if the portal has custom steps.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: procurement_checklist_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), tiered_capacity_addendum_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Sally Chen <sally.chen@acme-corp.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme-corp.com>, Tim Park <tim.park@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 13:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal readiness: procurement portal refresh & tiered capacity addendum

Diego — thanks for the clear outline. A few clarifications so we can queue this on our side: 

- We require a completed vendor onboarding questionnaire and a current SOC2 report before we enable portal vendor privileges. Can you provide both?
- Our AP prefers net-60 for new renewals; please confirm Redwood can accept net-60 or if you need to propose net-45.
- Portal: we can send an invite but we need the vendor's legal entity name and remit-to/billing contact for our manifest. Can you supply that?

I attached our procurement_requirements.pdf (short checklist). Once we get the SOC2 and onboarding questionnaire we can send the portal invite and route to our AP queue.

Sally Chen
Procurement Lead, Acme Cloud Services
procurement@acme-corp.com
Attachments: procurement_requirements.pdf
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sally Chen <sally.chen@acme-corp.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal readiness: procurement portal refresh & tiered capacity addendum

Thanks Sally — attaching the items you requested.

Quick answers up front:
- SOC2: attached SOC2-TypeII-2025.pdf (most recent).
- Vendor onboarding questionnaire: included inside redwood_vendor_onboarding_packet.zip ("vendor_questionnaire.pdf" and onboarding steps).
- Legal entity / remit-to: Redwood Inference, Inc. / Remit: finance@redwood.com / Redwood Inference, 1200 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103. Billing contact: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.com).

Suggested timeline (editable):
- Day 0 (today): Acme sends portal invite to vendors@redwood.com and confirms required fields.
- Day 1–2: Redwood completes questionnaire, uploads SOC2 and W9 via portal.
- Day 3–5: Acme AP queues PO and issues PO number; Redwood legal and Acme legal exchange/redline addendum.
- Day 7–10: PO signed and provisioning scheduled (+25% capacity uplift to start in next billing cycle).

We linked a short Mutual Action Plan here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_ACME (editable for both teams).

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_packet.zip (contains questionnaire), SOC2-TypeII-2025.pdf.

Please confirm when the portal invite goes out and whether AP needs the addendum attached as a separate line item on the PO.

Diego
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sally Chen <sally.chen@acme-corp.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal readiness: procurement portal refresh & tiered capacity addendum

Sally / team — looping in legal. I reviewed the addendum and made a few targeted redlines focused on payment terms and liability carve-outs.

High level:
- Payment term: we can accept net-60 for the quoted renewal if Redwood can secure an EWA exception on our side, otherwise net-45 is standard for renewals.
- Billing: please include a line item for the capacity addendum on the PO so finance can map it to the correct product SKU.

I will send the redline as addendum_redline.docx via DocuSign for signature routing; once legal is aligned we should be able to complete sign-off in 48 hours.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
Attachments: addendum_redline.docx
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Renewal readiness: procurement portal refresh & tiered capacity addendum

Internal update — short summary and next steps: 

- Portal invite received from Acme (link: https://app.procure-acme.com/invite/abc123). Acme confirmed they will queue our packet once we upload the questionnaire and SOC2 (done).
- Sally confirmed AP prefers net-60; Laura is proposing net-45 unless we secure EWA exception. Laura will send redline via DocuSign (tracking link in related_links).
- Next actions:
  * Laura: finalize redline and push DocuSign routing (ETA: 48h).
  * Marissa: confirm billing contact mapping and SKU for the capacity addendum so ApOps can accept the PO line.
  * Karthik: flag capacity uplift to provisioning team upon PO issuance (priority: high).

I will follow up with Acme once DocuSign is in flight and confirm expected PO date.

Thanks — Diego
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
